sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 5273 of 2023

Applicant :- Lanti Prasad
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Prem Babu Verma,Anita Singh,Kumari Poonam Rajpoot,Nirmla Kumari
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajai Kumar Srivastava-I,J.
Supplementary affidavit filed today by the learned counsel for the applicant is taken on record.

Heard Ms. Anita Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Ravi Prakash Bhatt, learned A.G.A. for
the State and perused the entire record.

The instant application for bail has been moved on behalf of the applicant, Lanti Prasad with the prayer to enlarge him on bail in F.I.R./ Case Crime No.24 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C.
and Sections 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Nagla Singhi, District Firozabad, during pendency of the trial.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the first information report is based on false and fabricated facts.
The accused/ applicant is innocent who has been falsely implicated in this case because of the fact that he happens to be husband of the deceased.
Her further submission is that initially a first information report came to be lodged against three named accused persons including the present applicant.

According to first information report, there are general and omnibus allegations against all the accused persons including the accused/
applicant who are stated to have demanded dowry and treated the deceased with cruelty due to non-fulfillment of demand of dowry.

Upon conclusion of investigation, charge sheet came to be filed Lanti Prasad vs State Of U.P. on 15 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28264970/
1 against all the accused persons including the accused/ applicant.

sentences.text: Her next submission is that according to postmortem report of the deceased, the cause of death of the deceased is reported to be asphyxia as a result of antemortem hanging.
There is no other external or internal injury reported on the person of the deceased except ligature mark mentioned in the postmortem report of the deceased.
The trachea and the hyoid bone were reported to be intact as no abnormality was detected in the postmortem report of the deceased.

Her further submission is that though the witness(s) of fact and the first informant have supported the prosecution case in their statements recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., however, the first informant, Kashiram, who is the brother of the deceased, and Kaptan Singh, who is the father of the deceased, have been examined in the learned trial court as PW-1 and PW-2 respectively, who have not supported the prosecution case and they have been declared hostile.
They have stated that the accused persons including the present applicant never demanded dowry and never treated the deceased with cruelty.

Learned counsel for the applicant has vehemently submitted that the other co-accused persons,
namely, Kamla Devi, who is mother-in-law of the deceased, and Sunharilal, who is father-in-law of the deceased, have already been granted bail by the coordinate Bench of this Court.
Learned counsel for the applicant has also submitted that the accused/ applicant is languishing in jail since 11.04.2022 who has no previous criminal history.

Her further submission is that in case, the applicant is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and he will also fully cooperate with the trial court in getting the trial concluded expeditiously.
He has also submitted that the applicant will not intimidate or pressurize the witnesses or any other persons acquainted with the facts of the present case.

Per contra, learned A.G.A. for the State has vehemently opposed the prayer for grant of bail by submitting that the accused/ applicant is named in the first information report who happens to be husband of the deceased.
The accused/ applicant has committed a heinous offence of murder of the deceased, his wife.
Therefore, the accused/ applicant does not deserve to be enlarged on bail.

However, he has been unable to dispute the other factual submissions advanced by the learned counsel for the applicant including the fact that the first informant, Kashiram, who is the brother of the deceased, and Kaptan Singh, who is the father of the deceased, have been examined in the learned trial court as PW-1 and PW-2 respectively, who have not supported the prosecution case and they have been declared hostile.

Having heard the learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and upon perusal of record, it transpires that a named first information report came to be lodged against three accused persons including the present applicant who happens to be husband of the deceased.
The cause of death of the deceased is reported to be asphyxia as a result of antemortem hanging.
There is no other external or internal injury reported on the person of the deceased except ligature mark mentioned in the postmortem report of the deceased.

Though the witness(s) of fact and the first Lanti Prasad vs State Of U.P. on 15 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28264970/
2 informant have supported the prosecution case in their statements recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., however, the first informant, Kashiram, who is the brother of the deceased, and Kaptan Singh, who is the father of the deceased, have been examined in the learned trial court as PW-1 and PW-2 respectively, who have not supported the prosecution case and they have been declared hostile.

sentences.text: They have stated that the accused persons including the present applicant never demanded dowry and never treated the deceased with cruelty.

The other co-accused persons, namely, Kamla Devi, who is mother-in-law of the deceased, and Sunharilal, who is father-in-law of the deceased,
have already been granted bail by the coordinate Bench of this Court.
The accused/ applicant is languishing in jail since 11.04.2022 who has no previous criminal history.

Thus, having regard to overall facts and circumstances of this case and also keeping in view the arguments advanced on behalf of the parties, the nature of offence, evidence regarding the complicity of applicant and without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case, a case for bail is made out.
The bail application is, thus, allowed.

The applicant shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer;
5.

The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence, in case the witnesses are present in court;
6. The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on the dates fixed for (i) opening of the case, (ii) framing of charge and (iii) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C.

If in the opinion of the trial court, default of this condition is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the trial court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of his bail and proceed against him in accordance with law.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
